label: US Social Security retirement
name: Name
quote: Estimate for the selected start or awarded benefit
amountHelp: Use the gross amount in today's dollars. Enter the amount for full retirement age to project changes from claiming early or late.
birthHelp: Enter your day of birth for SSA's age rules. The default assumes a birthday after the second day of the month.
payoutHelp: Your first eligible benefit month is at or just after age 62. Payments start the month after entitlement.
fullSummary: Monthly estimate at full retirement age
invalidPerson: Select one person with a valid birth year and month.
invalidBirthDay: Enter a valid day of birth for the selected person.
invalidCohort: Use an SSA quote for a person born before 1943.
invalidStart: Choose a start by age, date, retirement or milestone.
